Ninasunlover
London, United Kingdom1023 contributions

As good as we remember!
Apr 2026 • Family
We first visited 7 years ago, this time our hotel was a bit further away and we took a grab back to Asian kitchen as it's been etched in our memories ever since our first visit. The menu was still varied unfortunately we just had 2 nights to visit and the coconut chicken curry was not to be missed, I had this both days and it was absolutely delicious. Others in the group also had the curry and tried the pad Thai which was on special offer, they put a little list of offers on the table usually including on spring rolls for 50k and large Saigon green beer for 18k the cheapest around. The food was delicious, the staff friendly and welcoming, the atmosphere cosy and familiar, the offers fantastic value. Highly recommend!
